algorithm: Cycle-safe deterministic dependency propagation with evidence-gated lower, central, and upper graph bounds.
evidencePolicy: MODEL_INFERRED edges are excluded from lower and central estimates and enter only the upper missing-graph envelope.
limitations: The topology and all dependency weights are research assumptions, not reconstructed 2021 trade flows.
No case in the launch library currently has separated outcome data sufficient for historical scoring.
outOfScope: Investment, legal, sanctions-compliance, clinical, or emergency-response advice
